examples.description: Report a missing door after the listed tools fell short.

description: File a missing-capability report when no available tool can accomplish your task. The platform operator reviews these to decide what gets built next. Free; capped at 10 reports per tenant per day. Refuses: VALIDATION_ERROR when intent is under 10 characters (describe the task in a sentence), RATE_LIMITED after 10 reports in 24 hours (wait the retry_after seconds it carries).
